lesson: The confirmed runoff pair, Letlow's 45%-to-28% first-round lead and Trump's endorsement supported appropriately high confidence. Once a two-candidate runoff has both vote-transfer arithmetic and a strong endorsement aligned, concentration above 90% can be warranted.
Roster coverage preserved a positive score, but Alyssa Thomas's physical playing style and disciplinary exposure deserved at least parity with Copper in a suspension market.

The forecast over-anchored on the older ceasefire framing and ignored the NATO summit's newly dominant Iran-war agenda. For summit-policy questions, live agenda reporting and the exact type of proposed mission must override stale background assumptions; maritime security would have pointed to the Strait of Hormuz.

Kavanaugh was correctly ranked first from the conservative business-preemption slate. Maintaining broad authorship coverage was appropriate because the public argument evidence did not justify high concentration.
